turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello! Thank you for choosing AcmeBrands. How may I assist you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello. I ordered some jeans but they are way too tight. I look like Robert Plant from 1973.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm so sorry to hear that! Are you interested in returning the jeans?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes please.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I get your Full Name or Account ID, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Crystal Minh, Order ID: 8226176905

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I don't have my account ID, sorry

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Crystal Minh.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No worries! Would you please provide your Username and Email Address?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Username: cm149696, Email Address: cm149696@email.com

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Purchase validation in progress ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. And your Membership Level?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Gold all the way

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Membership level of Gold has been noted.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Awesome! You get unlimited returns as a Gold member. Are you able to return the jeans to us?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes I can. I don't have the packaging though.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem. Would you please provide your full street address so I may get you a shipping label?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: 4453 Primrose Ave  La Fayette, WA 50821

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Details of 4453 Primrose Ave La Fayette, WA 50821 have been entered.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And how would you like to process your return? We can do By Mail, In Store, or through a Drop Off Center.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can do it in store. There is a cute clerk that works there. :-)

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Order has been updated with In Store.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Nice! :) You're all set to return your jeans to the store that's most convenient to you. Is there anything more I may help with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's it, thanks for your help!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you so much for contacting AcmeBrands customer service. Have a great day!
